Privacy Policy

Last Updated: October 2025

Welcome to Asiye. We are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share your data.

1. Information We Collect

Personal Data: We collect your name, surname, vehicle details, and phone number during signup.

Location Data: To provide our service, we collect your real-time geographic location. This is essential for matching you with passengers and tracking parcels.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your data to operate the Asiye service, connect you with commuters, process payments, and ensure physical safety.

3. Account Deletion

In compliance with data protection rules (including Apple App Store Guidelines), you can delete your account at any time. Doing so will permanently erase your personal data, identity documents, and real-time location logs from our active systems.

Terms & Conditions

Last Updated: October 2025

By using the Asiye Driver application, you agree to these terms.

1. Use of Service

Asiye provides a platform to connect commuters and drivers. You must maintain valid driving permits and vehicle roadworthiness to use the platform.

2. Payments & Subscriptions

Premium features require an active verification or monthly subscription. Fees are non-refundable once the service period has commenced.

3. Code of Conduct

You agree to treat all passengers with respect and follow all local traffic laws. Violation of these rules may result in immediate suspension.
